title: Tilings with at least one colored domino
summary: Separate the all-square tilings of a row from the tilings containing a domino. Choosing the first domino gives a weighted sum for the second class, for any number of square and domino colors.

tasks.title: Extend the weighted sum
tasks.claim:
∀ a b n : ℕ, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), tiles a b k * a ^ (n + 1 - k)) =
    a * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), tiles a b k * a ^ (n - k)) + tiles a b (n + 1)
tasks.role: Gives the recurrence of the sum after adding one cell.
tasks.context: Split off the last term with Finset.sum_range_succ. For every remaining index k ≤ n, the exponent increases by one, so an extra factor a can be taken out of the sum.

tasks.title: Separate the first domino from the square prefix
tasks.claim: ∀ a b n : ℕ, tiles a b (n + 2) = a * tiles a b (n + 1) + b * tiles a b n
tasks.role: Identifies each step of the board count used in the assembly induction.
tasks.context: A first square uses one of a colors, and a first domino uses one of b colors. The remaining board gives the two terms. The same relation is the defining recurrence, so unfolding tiles once verifies it.
